Trump says the Iran war is 'militarily effectively over' and further US strikes are 'quite unlikely' after meeting Qatar's prime minister; Rubio reports no progress in talks and Iran repeats its conditions.
US-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine opened in Abu Dhabi on 10 November, the first in nine months; European officials met delegations outside the three-way format.

US officials say their Abu Dhabi plan includes a new security architecture between Russia and Europe and possible sanctions relief; France says European security cannot be negotiated before a ceasefire.
France blamed Iran's Revolutionary Guard for cyberattacks that disabled supermarket fridges and says it will summon Iran's ambassador and seek EU sanctions.
The US moved refuelling tankers out of RAF Mildenhall over an Iran-linked threat and raised security at two British bases, the Wall Street Journal reported.
A Houthi attack on Riyadh damaged an Aramco office tower on 8 November and a pipeline in the Medina region caught fire on 9 November; Saudi Arabia reported no casualties.
A drone killed a worker at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant, the IAEA said, a day after the plant lost its only external power line for about 10 hours.
China extended its trade truce with the US by two months to 10 January; Trump says he expects to meet Putin and Xi at APEC in Shenzhen on 18-19 November.
